## Analysis overview

Restricts to efficacy subjects completing Week 24 and excludes LOCF-derived records, then summarizes baseline, Week 24, and change from baseline by treatment.

## ADaM datasets

- `ADQSADAS`

## Key ADaM variables

- `COMP24FL`: Week 24 completion flag
- `EFFFL/ANL01FL`: efficacy and analysis flags
- `DTYPE`: derivation type, used to exclude LOCF
- `PARAMCD`: ACTOT parameter
- `AVAL/BASE/CHG`: analysis, baseline, and change values
- `TRTP/TRTPN`: planned treatment.
